replay_reproducibility.why_not_bitwise: The committed score is a dated reveal and is not regenerated. Commit 844173c anchored the binomial tail recurrence at the distribution mode, removing a silent underflow that zeroed the tail above about 790 sites. That is a reassociation of the same sum, so every channel built on the tail moves in its last few floating-point digits and a replay of the frozen kernel no longer reproduces the 2026-08-28 bytes exactly.
replay_reproducibility.tolerance_rationale: Every covariance entry that moved is smaller in magnitude than the absolute tolerance, so the relative tolerance is set by the decision-bearing leaves, whose largest move is 2.6e-10. A regression that mattered -- a flipped sign, a dropped batch, a changed projector or jackknife normalization -- would move these numbers by 1e-2 or more, so 1e-8 leaves about forty times headroom over rounding while staying a million times tighter than anything worth catching.

batch_contract.cross_size_alignment: identical zero-based batch ids and samples per batch across all four sizes
batch_contract.delete_one_rule: intrinsic thermal coordinates, projectors, roots, and residuals are recomputed in every synchronized delete-one replicate

response_families.X_even_X_odd: even/odd combinations of lineage-oriented matching contrasts at intrinsic mean-matching levels
response_families.mean_slope: first p derivative of the orientation-mean matching function at its implicit zero
response_families.root_gap_lineage: lineage-oriented difference of the two implicit orientation roots

sprime_replication.classification: fresh-seed replication at geometries present in retrospective source; no target refit

semantic_boundary: X_even/X_odd, intrinsic levels, mean slope, implicit roots, lineage residuals, and N-power normalizations are response/model coordinates rather than new registered topology identities.
evidence_boundary: The P49 families and P48 projectors reuse the same four aligned histogram blocks and are correlated summaries, not independent evidence rows. The fresh-seed S-prime replication uses geometries already present in the retrospective source and performs no target refit. The normalized positive P4 ratio and the unnormalized negative H4 lineage character remain distinct contracts.
